newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money rates soar on borrowing pressure.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money rates soar on borrowing pressure.

text.p: Pakistani money market rates closed sharply up on Monday on borrowing pressure after withdrawals of foreign currency deposits, dealers said.
"Unexpectedly, the overnight call money rates soared to 17 percent owing to heavy withdrawals of foreign currency deposits from the banking system," one dealer said.

Major trades were done between 2.00 and 2.50 percent in the morning but heavy borrowing pressure was seen in the market in the last hour, the dealer said. Some banks availed of the central bank discount window facility for about 1.5 billion rupees. -- Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192
